24.note: w_int = ceil(P*DEN) >= P*DEN.  Verified statement, exact integers: for every edge (u,v), w_int(u,v) + phi(v) - phi(u) <= rho*DEN.  Hence for every cycle C, (1/|C|) sum P <= rho.  The pressures P themselves come from floating-point transfer-operator arithmetic on exact 3-adic input -- the only inexact step. The graph contains ONLY states and transitions observed in the 30 true low-frequency environments (lambda in {1,3,5,7,9,11,13,17,19,23,25,29,31,101,1025}, J in {400,800}); it is NOT a bound over all 3-adic units.
